timeline.event: Renato arrives at the office on Sunday, as was his habit, to 'catch up on reports nobody asked for'
Patrícia enters the building via the parking garage (badge swipe logged). She takes the stairs to avoid the lobby camera.
Patrícia places a doctored energy drink on Renato's desk while he is in the bathroom. She retreats to her own office.
Renato returns to his desk. Finds the energy drink, assumes it was left by Gonçalo as a peace offering.
Renato drinks approximately half the can over the next 15 minutes.
Renato begins to feel unwell. He calls Gonçalo, who doesn't pick up.
Patrícia, still in the building, prints a document from her workstation — an alibi memo she backdated to appear sent on Friday.
Renato loses consciousness. Cardiac arrest caused by taurine overdose compounded with his undisclosed heart condition.
Patrícia leaves the building via stairwell B. CCTV in the garage records her car exiting.
Cleaning staff discovers Renato slumped at his desk. The energy drink can is still on the desk, half-empty.

facts.truth: Patrícia was in the office on Sunday evening despite claiming otherwise.
The energy drink was purchased by Patrícia and had its label replaced to disguise a manipulated taurine concentration.
Renato never willingly consumed energy drinks. He considered them 'beverages for people who can't manage their own time.'
The printer log records a print job from Patrícia's workstation at 20:14 on Sunday.
Hélder was also in the office that evening, working on a server migration he hadn't reported. He saw Patrícia but said nothing.
Patrícia had received a disciplinary email from Renato the previous Thursday, threatening formal proceedings over falsified team hours.
Renato had an undisclosed hypertrophic cardiomyopathy diagnosis, making even a moderate taurine overdose potentially fatal.

motive: Patrícia stood to be formally dismissed following Renato's disciplinary report. She had falsified overtime records for three members of her team to cover for a project she had mismanaged. Renato had discovered the discrepancy during a routine audit.
method: Patrícia substituted a standard energy drink with one she had tampered with — concentrating the taurine content to approximately 8x the normal dose. Given Renato's heart condition (which she learned about from his HR file — a perk of being Head of HR), she calculated the risk correctly.
hidden_clues: The disciplinary_email in Renato's inbox is dated Thursday but was flagged as 'read' on Sunday at 19:48 — after Renato had already drunk the can
The vitamin_bottle in Patrícia's office contains the same concentrated taurine compound found in the drink
Hélder's server migration logs show he was actively working in the server room from 19:00 to 21:00 — he is a witness, not the culprit
